gates.evidence: First full run crashed per-source on 7 of 19 planned clips: `TypeError: list indices must be integers or slices, not float` in cut_frames (clips with <=40 cuts) and `TypeError: only integer scalar arrays can be converted to a scalar index` in the palette sampler (clips with <=40 thumbnails, i.e. every clip under ~40s). Root cause: the sub-sampling branches passed float times / arrays where integer indices were required. Both fixed in study_run.py the same day (two commits of the rig).
No partial receipts: metrics.json is written only after every measurement stage succeeds (crashed runs left no metrics.json, verified by receipt timestamps vs job logs).
All 6 receipts produced before the crash passed the deterministic gates when re-verified on 2026-09-17 (rig/verify_receipts.py).
